scope: Exactly303 inherited cusp links are bounded in this frozen860-facet chamber. Every other inherited cusp has an unbounded new-coordinate link direction. Any finite-facet acute-compatible finite-volume completion retaining all860 actual facets needs at least two additional facets per missing cusp, because a nonzero causal old projection can be incident to only one old null ray and pure vertical caps conflict with retained height signs. This is a lower bound for retaining this core, not a nonexistence theorem and not a bound on other constructions.
